headline: ING forecasts New Zealand annual inflation at 3.8% ahead of report
summary: ING forecasted annual inflation in New Zealand at 3.8% ahead of the official September-quarter inflation report.
why: ING is a global financial institution that provides economic research and forecasts to help investors anticipate central bank interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: New Zealand
impacts.why: Inflation readings above central bank targets typically keep pressure on policymakers to maintain higher interest rates.
